sources.title: Understanding AI21 Labs Models and Their Functionality
sources.snippet: AI21 Labs models, also known as Jurassic models, are AI-powered tools designed to understand and generate human-like text. They are used in thousands of live applications across various sectors such as financial services, retail, customer support, and knowledge management.
